partner_result_applied.application: For the fixed exact-rank-three heavy-null family, conditioning only on original X_2 gives a physical triangular hyperbolic-square triple with a=1/2,b=1, hence ||p_Q||_infinity<=4sqrt(2).

new_result.statement: For a fixed exact-rank-three target with spectrum {1,-1,1} and leverage-1/2 zero pivot, fragmented cap-one iid inputs give scalar leakage T with E||p_(Y,Z|T)||_infinity^(2/3)=3[N-1+2^(2/3)]/(4N^(1/3)), which diverges like (3/4)N^(2/3). The actual Q remains uniformly bounded by 4sqrt(2) via the original-coordinate partner theorem.
